warnings: A computed path is a lower-terrain-cost path through the declared DEM model. It is not an astronaut traversability, hazard, trafficability, or safety certification.
DEM-to-CTX optical co-registration is unverified. Preserve published coordinates and do not use this route for fine-feature matching or operational navigation.
No verified Gale roughness, sand, rock-abundance, boulder, or obstacle dataset was available. The route avoids slope and elevation cost only; unmapped physical hazards are not represented.
Cost weights are documented algorithmic preferences, not validated EVA physiology, metabolic rate, oxygen use, battery drain, or safety thresholds.
Ascent and descent are raw sums of 30 m DEM elevation differences and include DEM noise; they are not surveyed rover-odometry values.
This route uses the 30 m HRSC regional DEM with approximately 90 m Horn gradient support. Boulders, small scarps, sand traps, and suit-scale obstacles are unresolved.
The shortest objective ignores terrain penalties and is expected to cross steeper ground when that reduces distance.
status is 'unverified': the graph search is deterministic and the source DEM provenance is verified, but local CTX co-registration is not.

algorithm.name: A*
algorithm.heuristic: great-circle ground distance; admissible and consistent because every edge cost is at least its ground distance
algorithm.tieBreak: f-score, then heuristic, then row-major cell index

costModel.name: gale-terrain-penalty-v1
costModel.interpretation: Algorithmic terrain preference, not astronaut physiology, metabolic cost, or a certified safety threshold.

slopeSupportMeters.note: Horn 3x3 support: three 30 m north steps; east support is three ground steps corrected by cos(planetocentric latitude), about 89.7 m at 4.7 deg S.

grid.horizontalDatum: Mars 2000 sphere R=3,396,190 m; planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude 0-360

coverage.missingTerrain: No numeric DEM is available outside the declared crop. Cells outside it are not treated as traversable.
coverage.nodataPolicy: Nodata and cells without a complete valid 3x3 slope neighbourhood are blocked. No interpolation, gap filling, or synthetic surface is used.
coverage.note: Coverage applies only to the audited regional crop for this dataset; it is not a claim of whole-Gale coverage.

source.publisher: ESA / DLR / Freie Universitat Berlin / NASA JPL
source.citation: Persaud et al. (2021), 30 m HRSC DTM mosaic of Gale Crater, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5808354
source.units: metres relative to MOLA areoid, positive up
source.note: Numeric elevation band was read directly. Display colours and rendered PNGs were not used as terrain data.

slopeSupportMeters.note: Horn 3x3 support: three 30 m north steps; east support is three ground steps corrected by cos(planetocentric latitude), about 89.7 m at 4.7 deg S.

processing.distanceModel: Mars 2000 sphere R=3,396,190 m, per-row cos(latitude) east spacing, 8-connected graph
processing.note: Slope, validity, distances, and pathfinding are covered by synthetic mathematical tests and authentic-DEM tests.

registration.reason: Precise local DEM-to-CTX co-registration is not certified. The DEM retains its published MOLA/Mars 2000 frame; no shift was fitted to the optical basemap.
registration.source: team/gale/G3_2_REPORT.md and team/gale/REGISTRATION_INVESTIGATION.md; G4_TERRAIN_AUDIT.json registration gate

hazards.reason: No verified Gale roughness, sand, rock-abundance, boulder, or obstacle dataset was available. The route avoids slope and elevation cost only; unmapped physical hazards are not represented.

resource_model.reason: Cost weights are documented algorithmic preferences, not validated EVA physiology, metabolic rate, oxygen use, battery drain, or safety thresholds.

limitations: 30 m posting is a grid spacing, not a guaranteed 30 m effective resolving power.
Horn 3x3 slopes have approximately 90 m support and smooth out boulders, small scarps, sand traps, and suit-scale obstacles.
Absolute horizontal/vertical accuracy and slope error are not quantitatively certified.
CTX optical co-registration is unverified locally; no shift was applied.
The crop covers the audited Gale exploration footprint plus a 1 km derivative buffer, not all of Gale Crater.
No roughness, obstacle, trafficability, or hazard dataset is included.
demonstrationNote: Demonstration inputs: recorded Curiosity traverse positions from public/maps/gale/curiosity-traverse.geojson. They are not certified mission targets, science-target coordinates, or astronaut traversability evidence.
